role: Charming adult male host/dealer accompanying the player, integrated physically and optically into the existing circus cabinet
composition: three-quarter body toward machine, face toward player
hip/forearm contact at matching burgundy/gold ledge
rear coat behind frame; contact hand in front
shared warm-gold upper-right light, red bounce, indigo shadows
protect reels and controls at all sizes
master: One high-native-resolution clean character, no 8-pose grid upscaling
animationPlan: After composition review: same-source painted layers, properly connected shoulder/elbow/wrist, painted occlusion fills, distinct advance/settle/recovery curves, 30fps baked output. Do not create independent AI images for every temporal sample or use whole-body rubber warp. First validate one second of arm motion before full sheets.
bigWin: Existing WIN overlay; character stays idle, no dedicated celebration
rejected: v3 8 drawings replayed as 15 references, texture boil and low-resolution cells
qualityGates: same original machine pixels in concept composite
constant-cadence motion probe before mass export
deployment: Local only; no Netlify, push, commit or version change

legMotion.status: Original crossed stance retained; prior IK trial rejected, no leg motion in current approved lean or R4 candidates.
legMotion.default: Relaxed crossed-leg host stance as in the selected composition
legMotion.scope: Consider occasional weight shift and a small uncross/reposition/recovery, not a foot gesture on every win
coordination: Establish and name the support foot before moving the free foot
Transfer weight through pelvis and hips; knees track toes without inward twist
Keep the supported forearm and ledge contact coherent with torso lean
Lift heel/toe only after unloading the moving foot; plant before transferring weight back
Maintain head/body/limb lengths and fixed camera; deliberate steps stay inside shared canvas
requiresPaintedArt: Correct upper/lower leg and boot views for the chosen movement
Occluded trouser/cape/inner-leg areas exposed during uncrossing
Foreground/background overlap when one leg passes the other
review: Short motion probe before full atlas
Review full body and leg crop at authored speed and slow playback
Support foot must not slide; no knee inversion, limb growth, foot penetration or sudden leg swapping
Foot contact shadows follow actual grounded foot; no foot shadow floating above floor
Review start/end transition and at least three cycles in actual PixiJS at desktop/mobile size
legMotion.reject: Do not approve from frame count or isolated stills; reject unnatural contact or weight transfer and do not wire it as completed animation

probe.drawingCountMeaning: Rig-rendered continuous poses, not 60 new AI drawings
probe.supportFoot: Provisionally A = rear boot on viewer-left; trace each leg to its hip before accepting this assignment. Redraw if the anatomy or occlusion cannot be resolved.
probe.activeFoot: Provisionally B = front boot on viewer-right

phases.beat: Transfer pelvis toward A, unload B; keep forearm contact
A knee absorbs; B heel lifts then leaves ground, driven by hip/thigh
B follows a small forward arc under its own hip to reduce crossing; toes track knee
B toe and sole plant gently, knee absorbs, brief settle
Weight returns to A; B recovers on a separate lower arc, cloth follows later
B restores crossed contact; pelvis/shoulders/sleeve settle without position or velocity snap

probe.reviewStatus: Design review only. No new motion has been generated or accepted.

currentAnimation: R4: one original source-coordinate surface. Face/neck/collars share one rigid transform; supported joints and original crossed legs fixed; clothing transition measured within 3 percent local stretch/compression at authored peak. No independently redrawn temporal poses or split bare elbow/wrist. Approved lean artifacts frozen.
